problems.title: Letter Case Permutation
problems.notes: simplest possible backtracking warm-up — branch on 'change case or don't' at each letter, good before N-Queens

problems.title: Letter Combinations of a Phone Number
problems.notes: backtracking over a digit-to-letters map — simple, but sets up the exact recursion template used everywhere else

problems.title: Word Search
problems.notes: DFS + backtrack on a grid: mark a cell visited in-place, recurse, then restore it on the way back up

problems.title: Palindrome Partitioning
problems.notes: backtrack over cut points; precompute isPalindrome[i][j] with DP so you never re-check the same substring

problems.title: Restore IP Addresses
problems.notes: backtrack with hard constraints (exactly 4 segments, each 0-255, no leading zeros) — pruning early is the whole game

problems.title: Combination Sum III
problems.notes: fixed count (k) AND fixed sum (n), digits 1-9 each used at most once — two simultaneous constraints to prune on

problems.title: N-Queens
problems.notes: THE canonical backtracking problem; track used columns and both diagonals with sets for O(1) conflict checks

problems.title: N-Queens II
problems.notes: same search as N-Queens but count solutions only — a good 'can you simplify unnecessary bookkeeping' check

problems.title: Sudoku Solver
problems.notes: backtracking + constraint propagation; row/col/box bitmasks speed candidate lookup up considerably over brute force

problems.title: Unique Paths III
problems.notes: backtracking that must visit every empty cell exactly once — a Hamiltonian-path-flavored constraint, not just reachability
